MATHEMATICS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #17
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MATHEMATICS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which is greater: 1/4 or 2/2? (1 mark)
   A. They are equal
   B. 2/2
   C. 1/4
   D. Cannot tell

2. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 11 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 34
   B. 17
   C. 22
   D. 66

3. Calculate 15 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 21
   B. 15.6
   C. 15
   D. 15.7

4. A square plot has side 9 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 81
   B. 18
   C. 90
   D. 36

5. Calculate 27 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 33
   B. 27.6
   C. 27
   D. 27.7

6. Solve for x: x + 4 = 14. (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 4
   C. 10
   D. 14

7. What is √49? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 8
   C. 24.5
   D. 49

8. Find the GCD of 37 and 49. (1 mark)
   A. 2
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 37

9. What is 1/4 as a decimal? (1 mark)
   A. 0.25
   B. 2.5
   C. 0.025
   D. 0.205

10. Calculate 23 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 23.6
   B. 23.7
   C. 23
   D. 29

11. Which fraction is equivalent to 6/8? (1 mark)
   A. 1/2
   B. 2/3
   C. 3/4
   D. 1/4

12. Find the GCD of 49 and 61. (1 mark)
   A. 49
   B. 1
   C. 1
   D. 2

13. Volume of a cube of side 3 cm is: (1 mark)
   A. 27 cm³
   B. 9 cm³
   C. 12 cm³
   D. 18 cm³

14. In the number 3141, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 400
   C. 40
   D. 10

15. What is 8 × 3? (1 mark)
   A. 11
   B. 25
   C. 5
   D. 24

16. A square plot has side 12 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 144
   B. 24
   C. 48
   D. 156

17. In a right-angled triangle, the two shorter sides are 5 cm and 12 cm. Find the hypotenuse. (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 17
   C. 7
   D. 15

18. What is 4 × 4? (1 mark)
   A. 16
   B. 8
   C. 17
   D. 0

19. What is 4 × 9? (1 mark)
   A. 13
   B. 5
   C. 36
   D. 37

20. Calculate 19 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 19.7
   B. 25
   C. 19.6
   D. 19

21. Find the perimeter of a rectangle 15 cm by 6 cm. (1 mark)
   A. 90
   B. 42
   C. 21
   D. 30

22. Simplify 6x + 2 + 6x. (1 mark)
   A. 6x + 2
   B. 6x
   C. 12x
   D. 12x + 2

23. A square plot has side 6 m. What is its area in m²? (1 mark)
   A. 42
   B. 36
   C. 24
   D. 12

24. In the number 3541, what is the place value of digit 4? (1 mark)
   A. 4
   B. 10
   C. 400
   D. 40

25. What is the square of 5? (1 mark)
   A. 25
   B. 5
   C. 10
   D. 26

26. What is 8 × 8? (1 mark)
   A. 0
   B. 16
   C. 64
   D. 65

27. What is the square of 11? (1 mark)
   A. 121
   B. 122
   C. 11
   D. 22

28. What is the square of 7? (1 mark)
   A. 7
   B. 14
   C. 50
   D. 49

29. Calculate 31 + 0.6. (1 mark)
   A. 37
   B. 31
   C. 31.7
   D. 31.6

30. What is 4 × 7? (1 mark)
   A. 3
   B. 29
   C. 28
   D. 11

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
